rules.title: Error Recovery
rules.description: Mistakes in a form are reported where the visitor can act on them. Objective check (client-side only): ask the browser to validate each form without submitting it, then check focus moved to the invalid field and a message exists. Forms that validate only in script, or have no constraints, are reported as needing a person: recovery cannot be tested without submitting, and Avara never submits.
rules.recommendationTemplate: Make each form say what is wrong and where, next to the field and in words: mark required fields, use the right input types, and move focus to the first mistake. {{observation}} Evidence: {{evidence}}
rules.evaluationPrompt: Interpret the measured evidence for "Error Recovery". Trigger a safe error and capture identification, correction guidance and retry. Do not guess beyond the measurements supplied.
requiredEvidence: each form with its fields and constraints
where focus went and the message shown
rules.userImpact: A visitor who makes a mistake and is not told where may give up instead of fixing it. This is a hypothesis from reading the page, not measured behaviour.
rules.businessImpact: Forms that do not guide recovery lose completions at the last step. This is a hypothesis from reading the page, not measured behaviour.
